# Amazon Timestream Query

Store Timestream scheduled queries and account query settings as records without executing queries or reading data.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `timestreamquery` |
| Signing name | `timestream` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.0 |
| API version | `2018-11-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 11 of 15 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-timestream-query) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only: scheduled queries never run and no query engine or stored time-series data exists.
- Query, PrepareQuery, CancelQuery and ExecuteScheduledQuery are not whitelisted and fail with NotImplemented.
- Scheduled query run summaries (LastRunSummary, RecentlyFailedRuns) and PreviousInvocationTime are never populated because queries do not execute.
- Real endpoint discovery returns service host names; DescribeEndpoints returns the client address with its scheme.
- IAM role trust and permission policies are not evaluated when creating scheduled queries or updating account settings.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
